def process(water2020, water2021, water2022, water2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    def prep(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = df.copy()
        out['Sample Date'] = pd.to_datetime(out['Sample Date'], errors='coerce')
        out['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(out['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        out = out[out['Beach Type Description'].str.strip().str.lower() == 'fresh']
        viol = out['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        out['isExceed'] = viol.isin(['yes', 'y'])
        out['month'] = out['Sample Date'].dt.month
        return out

    allw = pd.concat([prep(water2020), prep(water2021), prep(water2022), prep(water2023)], ignore_index=True)
    allw = allw[(allw['Year'] >= 2020) & (allw['Year'] <= 2023)]

    monthly = (
        allw.groupby(['Year', 'month'], dropna=False)
        .agg(exceedances=('isExceed', 'sum'), samples=('isExceed', 'size'))
        .reset_index()
    )
    monthly['exceedanceRate'] = monthly['exceedances'] / monthly['samples']

    # Ensure full grid 2020-2023 x 1-12
    grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([range(2020, 2024), range(1, 13)], names=['Year', 'month']).to_frame(index=False)
    monthly = grid.merge(monthly, on=['Year', 'month'], how='left')

    # Impute missing exceedanceRate using median of that month across non-missing years
    med = monthly.groupby('month')['exceedanceRate'].median()
    monthly['exceedanceRate'] = monthly['exceedanceRate'].fillna(monthly['month'].map(med))

    return monthly[['Year', 'month', 'exceedanceRate', 'samples', 'exceedances']].sort_values(['Year', 'month']).reset_index(drop=True)

def process(rainAmherst, rainAshburnham, rainBoston, rainChatham) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def tidy(df: pd.DataFrame, place: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Keep numeric Year rows only (drop Max/Min/etc.)
        out = df.copy()
        out['Year'] = out['Year'].astype(str).str.strip()
        out = out[out['Year'].str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}")]
        out['Year'] = out['Year'].astype(int)
        months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']
        out = out[['Year'] + months]
        # M denotes missing
        for m in months:
            out[m] = pd.to_numeric(out[m].replace({'M': np.nan, 'T': np.nan, '': np.nan}), errors='coerce')
        long = out.melt(id_vars=['Year'], var_name='mon', value_name='rain')
        mon_map = {m:i+1 for i,m in enumerate(months)}
        long['month'] = long['mon'].map(mon_map).astype(int)
        long['place'] = place
        return long[['place','Year','month','rain']]

    allr = pd.concat([
        tidy(rainAmherst, 'Amherst'),
        tidy(rainAshburnham, 'Ashburnham'),
        tidy(rainBoston, 'Boston'),
        tidy(rainChatham, 'Chatham'),
    ], ignore_index=True)

    allr = allr[(allr['Year'] >= 2020) & (allr['Year'] <= 2023)]

    # average rainfall across places for each Year-month
    monthly = allr.groupby(['Year','month']).agg(rainfall=('rain','mean')).reset_index()

    # full grid and month-median imputation
    grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([range(2020, 2024), range(1, 13)], names=['Year', 'month']).to_frame(index=False)
    monthly = grid.merge(monthly, on=['Year','month'], how='left')
    med = monthly.groupby('month')['rainfall'].median()
    monthly['rainfall'] = monthly['rainfall'].fillna(monthly['month'].map(med))

    return monthly.sort_values(['Year','month']).reset_index(drop=True)

def process(freshExceedanceMonthly, rainMonthlyAvg) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = freshExceedanceMonthly.merge(rainMonthlyAvg, on=['Year','month'], how='inner')
    df = df.sort_values(['Year','month']).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Aggregate to annual means (equally-weighted across months)
    annual = df.groupby('Year').agg(
        exceedRate=('exceedanceRate','mean'),
        rainfall=('rainfall','mean')
    ).reset_index().sort_values('Year')

    # Compare direction of year-to-year changes
    annual['dExceed'] = annual['exceedRate'].diff()
    annual['dRain'] = annual['rainfall'].diff()

    def sign(x: float) -> float:
        if pd.isna(x):
            return np.nan
        if x > 0:
            return 1.0
        if x < 0:
            return -1.0
        return 0.0

    annual['sExceed'] = annual['dExceed'].apply(sign)
    annual['sRain'] = annual['dRain'].apply(sign)

    # same trend if for each consecutive year pair, the sign matches (including both 0)
    comp = annual.dropna(subset=['sExceed','sRain']).copy()
    same = bool((comp['sExceed'] == comp['sRain']).all())

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'sameTrend': same,
        'annualExceedRate2020_2023': annual.set_index('Year')['exceedRate'].to_dict(),
        'annualRainfall2020_2023': annual.set_index('Year')['rainfall'].to_dict(),
        'yearToYearSignExceed': comp.set_index('Year')['sExceed'].to_dict(),
        'yearToYearSignRain': comp.set_index('Year')['sRain'].to_dict(),
    }])

    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = freshExceedanceMonthly.merge(rainMonthlyAvg, on=['Year', 'month'], how='inner')
    df = df.sort_values(['Year', 'month']).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Annual means (equally weighted across months). Use skipna=True (pandas default).
    annual = (
        df.groupby('Year', as_index=False)
          .agg(exceedRate=('exceedanceRate', 'mean'), rainfall=('rainfall', 'mean'))
          .sort_values('Year')
    )

    # Year-to-year differences (2021-2020, 2022-2021, 2023-2022)
    annual['dExceed'] = annual['exceedRate'].diff()
    annual['dRain'] = annual['rainfall'].diff()

    def sign(x):
        if pd.isna(x) or x == 0:
            return 0
        return int(np.sign(x))

    comp = annual.loc[annual['Year'] > annual['Year'].min(), ['Year', 'dExceed', 'dRain']].copy()
    comp['sExceed'] = comp['dExceed'].map(sign)
    comp['sRain'] = comp['dRain'].map(sign)

    same = bool((comp['sExceed'] == comp['sRain']).all())

    # Return only primitive columns (avoid dict/struct types that can break serialization)
